plain: To add a smaller thing to a larger one, as a country does when it takes over a territory

webster.text: To unite at the end; as to annex a codicil to a will.

more.text: To unite, as a smaller thing to a greater; as to annex a province to a kingdom.

example.quote: Nothing, therefore, can be wiser in that kingdom, than to annex to the king a constitutional council, who may be responsible to the nation for the advice they give.
